column1: # The reader's closed word classes: one word per line, then the classes it
# belongs to (comma-separated): determiner, aux, copula, preposition, modifier,
# cardinal (number words; a run of digits is a rule), time_adverb, place_adverb,
# adjective (the fallback set used only when the POS lexicon is not primed).
# Append a word, or a class to a word, to teach the reader.
